market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH ~$2,315 on Apr 29, 2026. February 2026 low was ~$1,746-$1,755 (Feb 5-6). For Yes, needs to dip another ~14% below that recent floor to $1,500. From current spot, that requires ~35% drop. ETH is more volatile than BTC and dropped ~50% in Feb crash; a retest is plausible but a fresh deeper low is less than coin-flip with 8 months left.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether macro / risk-off conditions force a fresh leg lower below the February capitulation low.
